limitations: Inclusive provider log coverage is bounded to the recorded interval and four selected tokens.
Matching block post-state does not assert that no other same-block transaction touched the token.
Minimum changes do not prove a bridge-out suspension or future scheduled execution.
A single authenticated provider supplied 36 contiguous log queries over Ethereum blocks 25781632–26132696. Exact block/chain anchors, receipt events and historical before/after calls were checked.
The four selected tokens have two observed minimum-update transactions. This does not cover other token events, every governance action or earlier history.
A minimum of uint256.max restricts ordinary source deposits; it is not deletion of the token mapping or proof of withdrawal suspension.
The September 28 SolvBTC/xSolvBTC on-chain update precedes the September 29 notice. Neither coordinate proves a future withdrawal transaction or resolves the notice's inconsistent asset wording.
This supplement resolves the earlier provider-access gap for its exact history only. Existing evidence, review deadlines, route and writer support remain unchanged.
Private authentication is excluded from this artifact; provider identity is a label, not a reusable endpoint configuration.
